I wrote the latest of my occasional guides to which AI to use right now for non-experts who want to get stuff done.

The agentic systems available to everyone are getting extremely powerful (even as the names and features continue to be really confusing): https://t.co/0H1p6QNrTd
The guy who invented AI context profiles is sharing the sauce on creating a personal knowledge base, highly recommend giving this a read

Incredibly bullish on AI tools for creators, contractors, and small businesses.

People who are time-constrained can hugely benefit from AI agents who take over admin (and other) work.

They often can't afford to hire humans to do these tasks - AI is the first "help" they get. https://t.co/q1nvYCfSrV

The early adopters of many AI tools - from assistants like @TownAI to video agents - are folks like real estate agents, contractors, and SMB owners.

An hour of time saved daily boosts quality of life.
